summary: Stop Qwen QSA from corrupting the KV cache when CUDA graphs are larger than the decode-row limit
compatibility: No user action required. The shipped profile was not affected; deployments that lowered max-num-seqs without lowering the CUDA graph capture size were.
details: Mixed batches replayed in graphs with more rows than max-num-seqs times (1 + draft tokens) could write another request's compressed KV page, causing wrong output without an error, or an illegal memory access.
QSA now sizes captured graphs for the full model length.
